_comment: Expected tool results for the scenario, derived from ../../fixtures/github/milestone-list.json and milestone-detail.json by mapGithubMilestone. Synthetic data only. Nothing consumes this today - see ../../overview.md (status: planned).
_assertions: step 1 carries no totalCount - the milestones endpoint reports no total, unlike search
truncated is false because 4 rows came back against the default limit of 60
dueOn is renamed from the API's due_on in both steps
description and dueOn are null on milestone 4, carried through rather than omitted
no open_issues, closed_issues, closed_at or html_url appear in step 1 - the compact shape drops them
openIssues and closedIssues appear ONLY in step 2 - this is the whole difference between the two tools
the number passed to step 2 is 3, read from the row whose title is v1.2, never guessed
milestone 3 here is a different object from issue 3 in issue-list.json - the sequences are unrelated
milestone 1 is closed with openIssues outstanding, so closed does not imply complete
